user.title: Pond and heat pump
user.description: Link the pond temperature, the heat pump and its power. The next steps (prices, solar, COP) are optional.

data.name: Name
data.inlet_temperature: Water inlet temperature of the heat pump

data_description.heat_pump: Its setpoint is changed to switch between off, low and high.
data_description.inlet_temperature: The setpoint follows this temperature. Without it, the rounded pond temperature is used.

prices.title: Prices and weather
prices.description: Optional. Without a price sensor the planner only minimises energy. Without a weather entity it uses the current outdoor temperature for the whole horizon.

data_description.price: A sensor with a list of today's and tomorrow's prices in its attributes.
data_description.price_forecast: Extends the horizon beyond the known prices, e.g. a day-ahead price forecast.
data_description.weather: Its hourly forecast gives the outdoor temperature over the horizon.

solar.title: Solar power
solar.description: Optional. Own solar surplus is valued at the feed-in price (see the options). Leave empty if you do not want this.

data_description.solar_forecast: Hourly PV forecast; without it the surplus only counts for the current quarter.

cop.title: COP
cop.description: Optional. With the water outlet temperature (and the inlet from step 1) the COP is calculated from the flow. The pond method needs no extra sensor.

data.outlet_temperature: Water outlet temperature of the heat pump
data.air_inlet_temperature: Air inlet temperature of the heat pump

data_description.energy: Energy counter; without it the power sensor is integrated.
data_description.air_inlet_temperature: Used for the COP per outdoor temperature; without it the outdoor sensor is used.

reconfigure.title: Pond and heat pump
reconfigure.description: Change the linked entities. Optional links can be emptied to remove them.

data.inlet_temperature: Water inlet temperature of the heat pump

data_description.heat_pump: Its setpoint is changed to switch between off, low and high.
data_description.inlet_temperature: The setpoint follows this temperature. Without it, the rounded pond temperature is used.

error.price_not_recognised: This sensor has no price list in a recognised format.

abort.already_configured: This heat pump already has a planner.

init.title: Planner settings
init.description: Changes take effect immediately (the planner restarts).

data.settle_minutes: COP: settle time after a start

data_description.price_multiplier: Effective price = price × multiplier + addition. For a bare exchange price in the Netherlands: 1.21 and about 0.136.
data_description.feed_in_multiplier: Value of own solar power. Equal to the purchase price (1 and 0) means net metering: solar then does not change the plan.
data_description.start_penalty: Higher: fewer starts at a slightly higher cost.
data_description.margin: The plan stays this far inside the band to absorb prediction errors.
data_description.surcharge_auto: Every night the last 14 days are replayed and the surcharge with the lowest real cost is chosen.
data_description.offset_low: Setpoint = rounded inlet temperature + offset of the mode.

heat_pump_not_following.title: Heat pump does not follow the planner
heat_pump_not_following.description: {entity} has not followed the mode set by the planner for two hours. Check that the heat pump is on, that no other automation changes its setpoint, and that the setpoint offsets in the options suit this heat pump.
